goal: Extract all remaining page272 structural-semantic evidence from one trustworthy rendered target HTML/DOM payload, and compare the source from one matching reference payload when available.

extract_exact.headings: ordered array of {tagName/level, normalized visible text}; do not collapse duplicates
extract_exact.reviews: root count, tablist count/name, ordered tab count/current visible identity/current accessible name, .af-review-source-dot count/tabindex/aria-hidden
extract_exact.form: Form33 wrapper count, form count/name/aria-describedby target text, direct-call owner/id/text/href, service wrapper role/aria-labelledby and label text, city input aria-describedby and help text
extract_exact.proof_carousel: container role, direct item count, each emitted item role, parent role(s), accessible names/current active marker and stable owner classes/data attributes
extract_exact.hero: hero art element ancestry plus ordered hero-copy heading/paragraph/CTA descendants of candidate ancestors
extract_exact.gallery: Sövénymunkák heading node ancestry and b2e2c001 ancestry
extract_exact.form_outer: af2e004c ancestry and Form33 wrapper ancestry

lowest_common_ancestor_method.hero: Find the nearest common ancestor of the full source-equivalent hero copy block and .elementor-element-af2e004e. Candidate is acceptable only if it does not swallow the following reviews/content section and has a stable Elementor/project identity.
lowest_common_ancestor_method.gallery: Find nearest common ancestor of the heading whose normalized text is exactly Sövénymunkák and .elementor-element-b2e2c001. Do not use b2e2c001 alone unless the heading is actually inside it.
lowest_common_ancestor_method.form: Find nearest common ancestor of .elementor-element-af2e004c and .mf-form-wrapper[data-form-id=33]. Candidate is acceptable only if it corresponds to the complete source form section and does not also include unrelated preceding/following sections.
lowest_common_ancestor_method.rule: A very broad page/main/root ancestor is not an acceptable named-region owner merely because it contains both nodes. Require a section-scale stable owner.

source_comparison.headings: compare ordered {level,name} arrays, not only name sets
source_comparison.proof_carousel: compare item/parent roles and accessible naming; historical source role=group must be re-observed before any target correction
source_comparison.regions: compare source region names and their actual section boundaries against the target LCA candidates
source_comparison.reviews_form: compare post-runtime accessible names/relations after any ID36 v004 deployment

v004_deployment_gate_from_same_payload: visible/current identities in Panasonic -> Otolecz -> ARKER'S order
Form33 wrapper count=1 and form count=1
followup_rule: Record diagnostic output first. Never expand the ID36 v004 write in the same package just because another discrepancy is discovered. Each new real delta gets a separate smallest-owner plan after source/target proof.
browser_memory_rule: If browser is used, reuse exactly one source + one target tab. No extra tabs; stale URL/title vs DOM/screenshot mismatch invalidates the payload immediately.
